tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search SuntekStore's catalog of hard-to-find specialty parts and tools (ships free to the US). Filter by keywords, hobby category, price range (USD) and maximum delivery days; sort by relevance, price, newest or fastest delivery (any sort other than relevance first groups results by how closely they

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full facts for one product by SKU (e.g. ST-54137787): specs, price, stock, delivery, returns, links.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Store policies: shipping (US only, free), delivery times, 30-day returns, tax, payment, how to buy.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Validate SKU and quantity and return a link the shopper opens to pay on Stripe Checkout. This does not charge anything or reserve stock; the shopper completes payment themselves.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Put several products (with quantities) into one order and get a single Stripe Checkout link for the shopper. Every line is checked against current price, listing status and stock. The shopper opens the link, enters a US shipping address and pays; sales tax is added there. Nothing is charged by this

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Look up an order by order number (like ST2610010001) and the email used at checkout. Returns status, items, carrier, tracking number and estimated delivery. No personal details are returned.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_order_status · Public sink: get_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_order_status · Public sink: get_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
